svg.text: Panel controls: J3 → 10 kΩ linear pot; J4 → maintained SPDT center-OFF switch.
STOP = both contacts open; both closed is a fault. Debounce in firmware.
Startup/reconnect requires STOP and knob below 2%, then a deliberate direction selection.
Open pot wiper pulls command to zero. Control cables ≤150 mm inside enclosure.
Blue: control power present. Green: armed/ready or running.
Red: latched fault; turn to STOP and set knob to zero.
Reversal requires ramp-down, coast and re-arming.
Open-loop duty control: speed depends on the mechanical load.
